overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the three members who stayed after adjournment spoke individually with non-members, and no quorum communication or other meeting was found.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Commission deliberated after an August 19 public meeting was adjourned, while members remained in the room.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that the Commission did not deliberate outside of a posted meeting and did not violate the Open Meeting Law.
